ns2:course.label: Casualty Actuarial Science
ns2:course.description: Principles and fundamental techniques of ratemaking for casualty and property insurances; risk classification; coinsurance; estimation of claim liabilities; financial reporting; catastrophe modeling. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Credit is not given for MATH 479 and MATH 569. Prerequisite: Math 408.
